verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer's Employment & Labor practice documents a firm-provided self-service tool for employment offer letters, proprietary information (confidentiality) agreements, and invention assignment agreements, backed by its Contract Generator platform. The documented model is client self-service rather than the firm preparing the paperwork, and full employment agreements are not named. missing for 10: explicit coverage of employment agreements, documentation of firm-prepared hiring paperwork beyond client self-serve templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm prepares hiring paperwork — offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements — as part of a documented employment practice

citations.quote: clients self-serve complex agreements such as employment offer letters, proprietary information agreements, and invention assignment agreements quickly and efficiently — at no cost to the client
Hundreds of our clients depend on our fully self-service Contract Generator platform
